_readme: Copy to data/filters.json and edit. Hot-reloaded by the running service within ~10s of saving. JS RegExp syntax, default flags 'iu'. Include patterns match post text + image/video alt text; exclude patterns additionally match link URLs (external card + links in text). Toggles gifPosts/quotePosts accept allow | exclude | only. Optional excludeListUri: an at:// URI of a Bluesky moderation list whose members' posts are dropped (refreshed hourly). A broken edit is rejected as a whole: the service keeps the previous config and logs the error (docker logs feedgen).
